title: finding(app-shell,i18n): flow expression notes stay English under zh-CN once objectui#10748 and objectui#10772 land (FlowExprIssue, the Problems panel, the Screen fields heading)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`). It comes from the dev report on objectui#10748 (`5857433868`, `out_of_scope_findings` 1 and 2) and the contract review of PR objectui#10800. That review showed the report's named carrier, PR objectui#10772's PR objectui#10792, is already frozen in the merge queue, and its head passes no locale at either site. The seat read every site at source; nothing was run.

## The sites

These are read at the heads of PR objectui#10792 (`8e4e5982af`, in the merge queue) and PR objectui#10800 (objectui#10748, landing). Both change these files.

1. **`FlowExprIssue`'s flow-scope note.** `flowScopeNote(value, role, scopeGroups)` calls `describeUnknownRefs(unknown)` with no locale. The note "`X` is not a reference in scope at this step." renders in English under zh-CN, although `engine.flowRef.*` has zh rows. Its siblings, `FlowEdgeInspector` and `FlowNodeConfigField`, pass their locale. This is the objectui#10696 class: the row exists, and the caller passes no locale.
2. **The Problems panel's expression messages.** `previews/flow-expr-problems.ts` has `checkCel` and `checkScreenVisibleWhen`, and both call `validateExpressionClient('predicate', value)` with no locale. `checkCel` already holds one. After PR objectui#10800 the messages have zh rows. So the inline cell shows zh and the Problems panel shows English for the same message.
3. **objectui#10772's two new strings.** Neither has a row:
   - the `'Screen fields'` group heading (`FlowObjectListField`'s `screenScopeGroups`). It renders as a `VariableTextInput` heading beside PR objectui#10800's zh group headings (`engine.flowScope.group.*`);
   - the screen `visibleWhen` note (`previews/screen-spec.ts`, `screenVisibleWhenScopeError`): "`X` is not a field on this screen (did you mean `Y`?)", plus its parse-refusal text. It shows in the inline cell and, prefixed with `Reason: `, in the Problems panel.

## Why it matters

A zh-CN author sees Chinese headings and picker words beside English notes in the same cell, and English in the Problems panel for a message the inline cell shows in Chinese. objectui#10748 should not be read as closing the whole designer-inspector i18n family.

## Direction (for triage to confirm or re-route)

The objectui#10586 / objectui#10748 shape:
- pass the designer locale at sites 1 and 2;
- give site 3's strings `engine.*` rows (en equal to the current literal, plus zh), with the en row the same text as today's literal;
- pin each under zh through the real component, with an en control.

Serial: this runs after PR objectui#10792 and PR objectui#10800 have both merged, since both edit these files.
